parsed.draft_response:
Hi there—thanks for the details. I’m sorry you’re running into this. We understand that starting this morning, the CSV export button on the invoice page is returning a 500 error, while customer exports are not affected, and that you’d like this resolved before Friday’s close.

We’ve flagged this for engineering investigation. To help us pinpoint the failing request quickly, could you share:
1) The exact invoice page URL/route where the export fails
2) The full 500 error details (message/body if shown, plus any request ID from the browser/network tab)
3) Whether it reproduces every time or intermittently
4) Any server/client logs or stack trace excerpts you may have access to
5) The approximate time the issue started and whether anything changed (deployments/config) around then

In the meantime, we understand you have a manual workaround available—please continue using that for now. Once engineering has the above inputs, we’ll follow up with next steps for restoring the CSV export on the invoice page.
